seo.title: Google BigQuery client for {devices}
seo.description: Query BigQuery with a service account, ADC or OAuth. Check bytes and cost with a Dry Run, cap spend with Max Bytes Billed, and export to Cloud Storage.

header.title: Google BigQuery client
header.lead: Write GoogleSQL, estimate what a query will cost before it runs, and cap the bytes a job can bill.

bands.title: Sign in to Google Cloud
text: Choose an <ui>Auth Method</ui> and enter the <ui>Project ID</ui>, not its name or number. <ui>Application Default Credentials</ui> uses gcloud’s login file, and <ui>Service Account Key</ui> takes a JSON file or a pasted key.

<cloudAuth>Google Account (OAuth)</cloudAuth> signs in through the browser with a desktop OAuth client you create in Google Cloud Console, and keeps one refresh token per client in the Keychain, so later connects open no browser. One OAuth client signs in one Google account, so a second account needs a second client. Everything goes through BigQuery’s REST API, so there is no host, port or SSH tunnel; <ui>Location</ui> sets the processing location of every job.

bands.title: Query and control cost
text: <ui>Dry Run (Cost)</ui> in the <explain>Explain</explain> menu estimates processed bytes, billed bytes and on-demand cost without running the query. After a query, the same figures show with its cache status, and <ui>Max Bytes Billed</ui> rejects jobs over a ceiling you set.

Completion, quoting and formatting follow GoogleSQL, and STRUCT and ARRAY columns show as JSON. Datasets stand in for databases, ⌘K moves between them, and a job is polled until the query timeout, then cancelled. UPDATE and DELETE from the grid match a row on its declared primary key, or on every column but ARRAY, JSON and GEOGRAPHY ones, so identical rows change together; declare PRIMARY KEY (…) NOT ENFORCED to edit one row exactly. On a partitioned table, write UPDATE and DELETE with a partition filter in the editor.

bands.title: Datasets and DDL
text: Run DDL from the editor, such as CREATE SCHEMA, ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN or CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW. New Database… creates a dataset, tables can be renamed from the sidebar, the DDL tab reads each definition from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES, and clustering and partitioning appear under Indexes.

moveData: Export a table or a query result to your Mac as {exportFormats}. Server-Side Export unloads CSV, Parquet or newline-delimited JSON to a gs:// prefix with EXPORT DATA, so the files never pass through your Mac.

faq.question: Which IAM roles does a BigQuery connection need?
faq.answer: roles/bigquery.user to run queries, roles/bigquery.dataViewer to read data and roles/bigquery.dataEditor to change it.

faq.question: Why filter instead of paging deep into a table?
faq.answer: Each page far into a table rescans the table from its start. Narrow the rows with a filter or a WHERE clause instead.
